perks.desc: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

perks.name: Roar of Battle

notes: SpaceMonkey (PvP): "Another relic from the past. The perks are decent, but the frame isn't the go-to in the meta right now, so I find it hard to get excited about this." Recommended MW: Range, Handling.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Aggressive(55) Kinetic Shotgun Special Ammo. "Astral Horizon graces yet again. No quickdraw but that’s okay. One-Two Punch and Pugilist are the best combos together, but lack a reliable reload perk. Surplus and Slideshot both reload your weapon but it’s not the same as Auto-Loading Holster or Grave Robber."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Aggressive(55) Kinetic Shotgun Special Ammo. "Most Crucible players should rejoice over this shotgun returning. The issue lies in its competition. Imperial Decree is easier to farm, has comparable stats, and while not getting adept mods, is able to stay stat for stat compared to Astral Horizon (Adept). Taking a look at both shotguns with Barrel Shroud, Accurized, Threat Detector, Opening Shot, and a Range masterwork / frame. Even with an adept Range mod on Atral Horizon both shotguns have the same range stat of 79, handling is actually best on Imperial Decree by 2 (43 to 41). Meaning it might just be better to farm out an Imperial Decree unless you really like glow on your weapons."
